description_for_human: Convert HTML and CSS code into native, editable Figma layers instantly — no Chrome extension required. Works with localhost, Storybook, auth-gated pages, React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Tailwind, Bootstrap, WordPress, and Gatsby.
description_for_model: html2design is a Figma plugin that converts raw HTML and CSS source code into native, fully editable Figma design layers. Users paste HTML from browser DevTools — no URL crawling, no Chrome extension required. The plugin processes HTML entirely inside the Figma Plugin API sandbox (no external server receives user data). Supported CSS frameworks: Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap 4/5, plain CSS, CSS-in-JS. Supported JavaScript frameworks: React, Next.js (App Router, Pages Router, SSR, SSG), Vue/Nuxt, Angular, Svelte/SvelteKit, Gatsby. Also works with WordPress themes (Elementor, Divi, Astra, custom PHP themes) and HTML email templates (MJML, table-based). Key use cases: reverse-engineering web UIs into Figma, design system bootstrapping from production code, developer-to-designer handoff audits, capturing dark mode/hover/mobile/responsive variants, and legacy website migration. Pricing: $12/month or $96/year via Figma Community. Resources: full documentation at https://www.htmltofigma.io/llms-full.txt, pillar guide at https://www.htmltofigma.io/guide, glossary at https://www.htmltofigma.io/glossary, changelog at https://www.htmltofigma.io/changelog.
